name: Vanishing Point -Tenshi no Kieta Machi-
source:
Kusanagi is a high school student. Recently, girls started to disappear from the area he lives. A friend of his sister requests to search for one such person.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-september-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
草薙是一名高中生。最近，他居住的地区开始有女孩接连失踪。姐姐的朋友委托他寻找其中一名失踪者。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-september-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
